newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: WOOLTRU LIFTS COUNTRY ROAD STAKE.
newsitem.headline: WOOLTRU LIFTS COUNTRY ROAD STAKE.

text.p: South African clothing retailer Wooltru Ltd has increased its holding in Australian upmarket clothing retailer Country Road Ltd to 19.74 percent from 14.86 percent, disclosure documents showed on Tuesday.
A substantial shareholder notice released by the Australian Stock Exchange showed Wooltru raised its holding to 10.32 million shares from 7.73 million on August 8.
Country Road shares closed at A$1.54 on Tuesday, down one cent on Monday's close.
The company said last week that full year earnings could be below the half year profit after abnormals of A$1.09 million due to subdued sales.
A director of Wooltru, Syd Muller, is already a member of the Country Road board.
